The '''54th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] and television for 1996, were held on January 19, 1997 at the [[The Beverly Hilton|Beverly Hilton]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Sterngold|first1=James|title=Madonna in Film and Aliens on TV Are Big Winners at Golden Globes|url=https://www.nytimes.com/1997/01/20/movies/madonna-in-film-and-aliens-on-tv-are-big-winners-at-golden-globes.html|access-date=11 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=20 January 1997}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Golden Globes for 'English Patient' and Madonna|url=https://www.nytimes.com/1997/01/21/movies/golden-globes-for-english-patient-and-madonna.html|access-date=11 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=21 January 1997}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Lowry|first1=Brian|last2=Puig|first2=Claudia|title='Evita,' 'Patient' Win Top Golden Globes|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1997-01-20-mn-20413-story.html|access-date=11 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=20 January 1997}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title='English Patient,' `Evita,' Madonna, Tom Cruise and `X-Files' big Golden Globe winners|url=http://chronicle.augusta.com/stories/1997/01/20/ent_202824.shtml|access-date=11 January 2018|work=The Augusta Chronicle|date=20 January 1997}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 19, 1996.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Puig|first1=Claudia|last2=Dutka|first2=Elaine|title='English Patient' Basks in Globe Nominations|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1996-12-20-ca-10838-story.html|access-date=11 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=20 December 1996}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Elber|first1=Lynn|title='English Patient' gets 7 Globe nominations|url=https://www.deseretnews.com/article/531875/ENGLISH-PATIENT-GETS-7-GLOBE-NOMINATIONS.html?pg=all|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140418220548/http://www.deseretnews.com/article/531875/ENGLISH-PATIENT-GETS-7-GLOBE-NOMINATIONS.html?pg=all|url-status=dead|archive-date=April 18, 2014|access-date=11 January 2018|work=Deseret News|date=20 December 1996}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Golden Globe Nominations|url=https://variety.com/1996/scene/vpage/golden-globe-nominations-2-1117436552/|access-date=11 January 2018|work=Variety|date=19 December 1996}}</ref>
